verses.original: Παῦλος δέσμιος Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ καὶ Τιμόθεος ὁ ἀδελφὸς Φιλήμονι ἡμῶν τῷ ἀγαπητῷ καὶ συνεργῷ
verses.transliteration: Paulos desmios Christou Iēsou kai Timotheos ho adelphos Philēmoni hēmōn tō agapētō kai synergō
verses.literal: Paul a prisoner of Christ Jesus and Timothy [our] brother To Philemon our - beloved - fellow worker

verses.original: καὶ Ἀπφίᾳ τῇ ἀδελφῇ καὶ Ἀρχίππῳ ἡμῶν τῷ συστρατιώτῃ καὶ τῇ ἐκκλησίᾳ κατ’ σου οἶκόν
verses.transliteration: kai Apphia tē adelphē kai Archippō hēmōn tō systratiōtē kai tē ekklēsia kat’ sou oikon
verses.literal: - to Apphia our sister - to Archippus our - fellow soldier and to the church [that meets] at your house

verses.original: Χάρις καὶ εἰρήνη ὑμῖν ἀπὸ Θεοῦ ἡμῶν Πατρὸς καὶ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: Charis kai eirēnē hymin apo Theou hēmōn Patros kai Kyriou Iēsou Christou
verses.literal: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and [the] Lord Jesus Christ

verses.original: Εὐχαριστῶ πάντοτε μου τῷ Θεῷ ποιούμενος μνείαν σου ἐπὶ μου τῶν προσευχῶν
verses.transliteration: Eucharistō pantote mou tō Theō poioumenos mneian sou epi mou tōn proseuchōn
verses.literal: I always thank . . . my - God remembering . . . you in my - prayers

verses.original: ἀκούων ἣν ἔχεις τὴν πίστιν πρὸς τὸν Κύριον Ἰησοῦν καὶ σου τὴν ἀγάπην καὶ εἰς πάντας τοὺς ἁγίους
verses.transliteration: akouōn hēn echeis tēn pistin pros ton Kyrion Iēsoun kai sou tēn agapēn kai eis pantas tous hagious
verses.literal: because I hear about - your - faith in the Lord Jesus and your - love - for all the saints

verses.original: ὅπως ἡ σου κοινωνία τῆς πίστεώς γένηται ἐνεργὴς ἐν ἐπιγνώσει παντὸς ἀγαθοῦ τοῦ ἐν ἡμῖν εἰς Χριστόν
verses.transliteration: hopōs hē sou koinōnia tēs pisteōs genētai energēs en epignōsei pantos agathou tou en hēmin eis Christon
verses.literal: [I pray] that - your partnership in the faith may become effective as you fully acknowledge every good [thing] that [is] vvv ours in Christ

verses.original: γὰρ ἔσχον πολλὴν χαρὰν καὶ παράκλησιν ἐπὶ σου τῇ ἀγάπῃ ὅτι σοῦ ἀδελφέ ἀναπέπαυται διὰ τὰ σπλάγχνα τῶν ἁγίων
verses.transliteration: gar eschon pollēn charan kai paraklēsin epi sou tē agapē hoti sou adelphe anapepautai dia ta splanchna tōn hagiōn
verses.literal: - I take great joy and encouragement in your - love because you brother have refreshed - the hearts of the saints

verses.original: Διό ἐν Χριστῷ ἔχων παρρησίαν πολλὴν ἐπιτάσσειν σοι τὸ ἀνῆκον
verses.transliteration: Dio en Christō echōn parrēsian pollēn epitassein soi to anēkon
verses.literal: So {although} in Christ I am bold enough to order you [to do] what [is] proper

verses.original: μᾶλλον παρακαλῶ διὰ τὴν ἀγάπην ὡς τοιοῦτος Παῦλος ὢν νυνὶ πρεσβύτης δὲ δέσμιος Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ καὶ
verses.transliteration: mallon parakalō dia tēn agapēn hōs toioutos Paulos ōn nyni presbytēs de desmios Christou Iēsou kai
verses.literal: vvv I prefer to appeal on the basis of - love [For] I Paul am now aged and a prisoner of Christ Jesus as well

verses.original: Παρακαλῶ σε περὶ ἐμοῦ τοῦ τέκνου Ὀνήσιμον ὃν ἐγέννησα ἐν τοῖς δεσμοῖς
verses.transliteration: Parakalō se peri emou tou teknou Onēsimon hon egennēsa en tois desmois
verses.literal: I appeal to you for my - child Onesimus whose father I became [while I was] in - chains

verses.original: ποτέ τόν ἄχρηστον σοι δὲ νυνὶ εὔχρηστον καὶ σοὶ καὶ ἐμοὶ
verses.transliteration: pote ton achrēston soi de nyni euchrēston kai soi kai emoi
verses.literal: Formerly - [he was] useless to you but now [he has become] useful both to you and to me

verses.original: ὃν ἀνέπεμψά σοι αὐτόν τοῦτ’ ἔστιν ἐμὰ τὰ σπλάγχνα
verses.transliteration: hon anepempsa soi auton tout’ estin ema ta splanchna
verses.literal: vvv I am sending back to you him who is my - very heart

verses.original: ἐγὼ ἐβουλόμην κατέχειν ὃν πρὸς ἐμαυτὸν ἵνα ὑπὲρ σοῦ διακονῇ μοι ἐν τοῖς δεσμοῖς τοῦ εὐαγγελίου
verses.transliteration: egō eboulomēn katechein hon pros emauton hina hyper sou diakonē moi en tois desmois tou euangeliou
verses.literal: I would have liked to keep [him] with me so that vvv on your behalf he could minister to me in [my] chains for the gospel

verses.original: δὲ ἠθέλησα ποιῆσαι οὐδὲν Χωρὶς σῆς τῆς γνώμης ἵνα σου τὸ ἀγαθόν ᾖ μὴ ὡς κατὰ ἀνάγκην ἀλλὰ κατὰ ἑκούσιον
verses.transliteration: de ēthelēsa poiēsai ouden Chōris sēs tēs gnōmēs hina sou to agathon ē mē hōs kata anankēn alla kata hekousion
verses.literal: But I did [not] want to do [anything] without your - consent so that your - goodness will not be . . . vvv out of compulsion but by your own free will

verses.original: γὰρ τάχα διὰ τοῦτο ἐχωρίσθη πρὸς ὥραν ἵνα ἀπέχῃς αὐτὸν αἰώνιον
verses.transliteration: gar tacha dia touto echōristhē pros hōran hina apechēs auton aiōnion
verses.literal: For perhaps this is why . . . he was separated [from you] for a while so that you might have him back . . . for good

verses.original: οὐκέτι ὡς δοῦλον ἀλλὰ ὑπὲρ δοῦλον ἀγαπητόν ἀδελφὸν μάλιστα ἐμοί δὲ πόσῳ μᾶλλον σοὶ καὶ ἐν σαρκὶ καὶ ἐν Κυρίῳ
verses.transliteration: ouketi hōs doulon alla hyper doulon agapēton adelphon malista emoi de posō mallon soi kai en sarki kai en Kyriō
verses.literal: no longer as a slave but better than a slave [as] a beloved brother [He is] especially [ beloved ] to me but even more so . . . to you both in person and in [the] Lord

verses.original: οὖν Εἰ ἔχεις με κοινωνόν προσλαβοῦ αὐτὸν ὡς ἐμέ
verses.transliteration: oun Ei echeis me koinōnon proslabou auton hōs eme
verses.literal: So if you consider me a partner receive him as [you would receive] me

verses.original: δέ εἰ ἠδίκησέν σε τι ἢ ὀφείλει τοῦτο ἐμοὶ ἐλλόγα
verses.transliteration: de ei ēdikēsen se ti ē opheilei touto emoi elloga
verses.literal: But if he has wronged you in any way or owes [you anything] vvv vvv charge it to my account

verses.original: ἐγὼ Παῦλος ἔγραψα τῇ ἐμῇ χειρί ἐγὼ ἀποτίσω μὴ ἵνα λέγω σοι ὅτι προσοφείλεις μοι καὶ σεαυτόν
verses.transliteration: egō Paulos egrapsa tē emē cheiri egō apotisō mē hina legō soi hoti prosopheileis moi kai seauton
verses.literal: I Paul write [this] with my own hand I will repay [it] not to mention - that you owe me vvv your very self

verses.original: Ναί ἀδελφέ ἐγώ ὀναίμην σου ἐν Κυρίῳ ἀνάπαυσόν μου τὰ σπλάγχνα ἐν Χριστῷ
verses.transliteration: Nai adelphe egō onaimēn sou en Kyriō anapauson mou ta splanchna en Christō
verses.literal: Yes brother vvv let me have some benefit from you in [the] Lord Refresh my - heart in Christ

verses.original: Πεποιθὼς σου τῇ ὑπακοῇ ἔγραψά σοι εἰδὼς ὅτι ποιήσεις καὶ ὑπὲρ ἃ λέγω
verses.transliteration: Pepoithōs sou tē hypakoē egrapsa soi eidōs hoti poiēseis kai hyper ha legō
verses.literal: Confident of your - obedience I write to you knowing that you will do even more than I ask

verses.original: δὲ Ἅμα ἑτοίμαζέ ξενίαν μοι καὶ γὰρ ἐλπίζω ὅτι διὰ ὑμῶν τῶν προσευχῶν χαρισθήσομαι ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: de Hama hetoimaze xenian moi kai gar elpizō hoti dia hymōn tōn proseuchōn charisthēsomai hymin
verses.literal: In the meantime . . . prepare a guest room for me - because I hope that through your - prayers I will be restored to you

verses.original: Ἐπαφρᾶς μου ὁ συναιχμάλωτός ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ Ἀσπάζεταί σε
verses.transliteration: Epaphras mou ho synaichmalōtos en Christō Iēsou Aspazetai se
verses.literal: Epaphras my - fellow prisoner in Christ Jesus sends you greetings . . .

verses.original: Μᾶρκος Ἀρίσταρχος Δημᾶς Λουκᾶς μου οἱ συνεργοί
verses.transliteration: Markos Aristarchos Dēmas Loukas mou hoi synergoi
verses.literal: [as do] Mark Aristarchus Demas [and] Luke my - fellow workers

verses.original: Ἡ χάρις τοῦ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ μετὰ ὑμῶν τοῦ πνεύματος
verses.transliteration: Hē charis tou Kyriou Iēsou Christou meta hymōn tou pneumatos
verses.literal: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ [be] with your - spirit
